final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: diode-connected reference sink
Mb  ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=2 L=2
* tail current source
Mt  tail ibias vss vss nfet W=2 L=2
* NMOS input pair (vinp on output side -> non-inverting overall)
M1  n1 vinn tail vss nfet W=4 L=0.5
M2  x  vinp tail vss nfet W=4 L=0.5
* PMOS mirror load
M3  n1 n1 vdd vdd pfet W=2 L=1
M4  x  n1 vdd vdd pfet W=2 L=1
* second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS current sink
M6  vout x vdd vdd pfet W=24 L=1
M7  vout ibias vss vss nfet W=12 L=2
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
Rz  x cz 50000
Cc  cz vout 1.2e-12
.ends dut
